Title: InfoMessageContentItem - Display-Only Content
Summary: Display-only content item extending KernelContent for UI messages that should not be sent to the LLM.
Content:
## InfoMessageContentItem

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Models`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Purely for display purposes in the chat UI. Extends `Microsoft.SemanticKernel.KernelContent` but is not sent to the LLM.

### Constructors
```csharp
public InfoMessageContentItem();
public InfoMessageContentItem(string fileName);
```

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `FileName` | `string` | Associated file name |

### Usage
Used by the chat UI to display informational messages (file uploads, status updates) that should appear in the conversation but not be processed by the LLM.

```csharp
var infoItem = new InfoMessageContentItem("document.pdf");
// Added to display history but filtered from kernel history
```

### Related
- `KernelContent` - Base class from Semantic Kernel
- `IChatMessageService` - Routes messages to display vs kernel history
- `ChatOptions` - Configures which roles are display-only
